OBJECT_COLOUR.description: Generic colour for gfx_LineTo, gfx_LineRel, gfx_Dot, gfx_Bullet and gfx_BoxTo

OP1_ADD.description: signed add each element of entire array with "value">

OP1_BLACKEN.description: saturate an array of RGB565 elements to black, "value" determines saturation.

OP1_DARKEN.description: decrease luminance of an array of RGB565 elements, "value" determines saturation.

OP1_DIV.description: signed divide each element of entire array by "value".

OP1_GRAY.description: convert an array of RGB565 elements to grayscale, "value" is ignored.

OP1_LIGHTEN.description: increase luminance of an array of RGB565 elements, "value" determines saturation.

OP1_MUL.description: signed multiply each element of entire array with "value".

OP1_REV.description: reverse the elements of an array (value is ignored).

OP1_ROL.description: rotate an array left by "value" positions.

OP1_ROR.description: rotate an array right by "value" positions.

OP1_SHL.description: shift an array left by "value" positions.

OP1_SHR.description: shift an array right by "value" positions.

OP1_SUB.description: signed subtract "value" from each element of entire array.

OP1_WHITEN.description: saturate an array of RGB565 elements to white, "value" determines saturation.

OP2_AND.description: "and" arrays, result to array1 (value is ignored).

OP2_BLEND.description: blend arrays, blend percentage determined by "value", result to "array1".

OP2_DIV.description: "divide array1 by array2" , result to array1 (value is ignored).

OP2_IOR.description: "inclusive or" arrays, result to array1 (value is ignored).

OP2_MUL.description: "multiply" arrays, result to array1 (value is ignored).

OP2_SUB.description: "subtract" array2 from array1, result to array1, array1-(array2+value).

OP2_XOR.description: "exclusive or" arrays, result to array1 (value is ignored).

OUTLINE_COLOUR.description: Outline colour for rectangles and circles(set to 0 for no effect)

PEN_SIZE.description: Set the draw mode for gfx_LineTo, gfx_LineRel, gfx_Dot, gfx_Bullet and gfx_BoxTo (default mode is OUTLINE)*

PWM_15KHZ.description: Plain PWM which value is a number between 0 and 1000. This corresponds to a 0.0 to 100.0% duty cycle. Raw Frequency is as specified.

PWM_1KHZ.description: Plain PWM which value is a number between 0 and 1000. This corresponds to a 0.0 to 100.0% duty cycle. Raw Frequency is as specified.

PWM_200HZ.description: Plain PWM which value is a number between 0 and 1000. This corresponds to a 0.0 to 100.0% duty cycle. Raw Frequency is as specified.

PWM_500HZ.description: Plain PWM which value is a number between 0 and 1000. This corresponds to a 0.0 to 100.0% duty cycle. Raw Frequency is as specified.

PWM_5KHZ.description: Plain PWM which value is a number between 0 and 1000. This corresponds to a 0.0 to 100.0% duty cycle. Raw Frequency is as specified.

PWM_625HZ.description: Plain PWM which corresponds to 62.5Hz, which takes a value from 0 to 160.

PWM_OFF.description: Turn off the PWM (pin is left as Output)

PWM_PLAIN.description: Plain PWM which value is a number between 0 and 1000. This corresponds to a 0.0 to 100.0% duty cycle. Raw Frequency is ~70kHz. A value of 1 is not valid.

PWM_SERVO.description: Servo PWM has a value which is between 100 and 200. This corresponds to 1.00 to 2.00ms. Please note values from 0 to 600 are valid (0-6ms) but should be used with caution. Repitition Rate is ~50Hz or 20ms.

PWN_BINARY.description: Binary PWM which value is a number between 0 and 1024. This corresponds to a 0.0 to 100.0% duty cycle. Raw Frequency is ~68kHz. A value of 1 is not valid.

TEXT_ANGLE.description: Sets the text angle, only for plotted fonts. The feature automatically resets when screen mode is changed.

TEXT_ATTRIBUTES.description: Allows a combination of text attributes to be defined together by 'or'ing the bits together. The feature automatically resets after printing using putstr or print has completed. Example: txt_Set(TEXT_ATTRIBUTES, BOLD | INVERSE); // bold + inverse Note: bits 0-3 and 8-15 are reserved.
TEXT_ATTRIBUTES.value: 16 or BOLD 32 or ITALIC 64 or INVERSE 128 or UNDERLINED

TEXT_BOLD.description: Sets Bold Text mode for the next string or char. The feature automatically resets after printing using putstr or print has completed.

TEXT_HEIGHT.description: Set the text height multiplier. Text will be printed magnified vertically by this factor.

TEXT_INVERSE.description: Sets Inverse Text mode for the next string or char. The feature automatically resets after printing using putstr or print has completed.

TEXT_ITALIC.description: Sets Italic Text mode for the next string or char. The feature automatically resets after printing using putstr or print has completed.

TEXT_MARGIN.description: text left pixel pos for carriage return

TEXT_OPACITY.description: Selects whether or not the 'background' pixels are drawn.

TEXT_PRINTDELAY.description: Set the delay between character printing to give a 'teletype' like effect.

TEXT_UNDERLINED.description: Sets Underlined Text mode for the next string or char. The feature automatically resets after printing using putstr or print has completed.

TEXT_WIDTH.description: Set the text width multiplier. Text will be printed magnified horizontally by this factor.

TEXT_WRAP.description: Sets the pixel position where text wrap will occur at RHS The feature automatically resets when screen mode is changed. If the value is set to 0, text wrap is turned off of the current screen. Note: The value is in pixel.

TEXT_XGAP.description: Set the pixel gap between characters. The gap is in pixel units.

TEXT_YGAP.description: Set the pixel gap between lines. The gap is in pixel units.

TOUCH_RAW_X.description: 12 bit raw A2D X value from touch screen

TOUCH_RAW_Y.description: 12 bit raw A2D Y value from touch screen

TRANSPARENCY.description: Turn the transparency ON or OFF. Transparency is automatically turned OFF after the next image or video command.

TRANSPARENT_COLOUR.description: Colour that needs to be made transparent.

TXT_FONT_ID.description: font type, 0 = system font, else pointer to user font"

TXT_FONT_MAX.description: max number of chars in font

WIDGET_F_FLASH.description: set if this is a flash based widget.

WIDGET_F_INITIALISED.description: Flag when 'base gauge needle, etc.' is done

WIDGET_F_INPUT.description: Set if this is an input (Used only with the IDE).

WIDGET_F_INTERNAL.description: Internal use only (force redraw on next write).

WIDGET_F_TOUCH_ENABLE.description: Set to disable touch for this image, (default=1 for movie, 0 for image).

WIDGET_F_UNDRAW_ONLY.description: Set to prevent draw of new needle.

WIDGET_HI_WORD.description: Flash offset high word (Flash widgets only).

WIDGET_LO_WORD.description: Flash offset low word (External Flash widgets only).
